blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water marks the 20th anniversary of Lakbayan, its flagship water trail education campaign that has helped thousands of stakeholders understand the value of water, responsible water use, and proper wastewater management. Lakbayan, a combination of the Filipino words lakbay and bayan, takes participants through the different stages of the water cycle. Through guided visits to Manila Water facilities, they see how raw water is collected from its source, treated, and distributed to communities, as well as how used water is collected and treated before being safely returned to the environment.
